description:
Count the New Zealand standard drinks in a drink, with grams of pure
    alcohol and calories from the alcohol.

    Use for: 'how many standard drinks in a bottle of wine', 'standard drinks
    calculator nz', 'how many standard drinks in a beer', 'standard drinks in a
    can of rtd', 'what is a standard drink nz', 'standard drinks in a shot'.

    ONE NZ STANDARD DRINK IS 10 GRAMS OF PURE ALCOHOL: volume (mL) x ABV / 100
    x 0.789 (the density of ethanol) / 10. A 330 mL can at 5% is 1.3 standard
    drinks, so a six-pack is nearly eight, and a 750 mL bottle of wine at 13% is
    7.7.

    THE SIZE IS NATIONAL. A UK unit is 8 g and a US drink 14 g; this counts the
    New Zealand drink only.

    ABV IS A PERCENTAGE: 5 for 5%, 40 for 40%. Values between 0 and 0.5 are
    refused as likely fractions.

    THIS DOES NOT ESTIMATE BLOOD OR BREATH ALCOHOL and never says anyone is
    safe, sober or fit to drive. Do not use it to answer whether someone can
    drive.

    THE LIMITS DIFFER BY SEX. Health New Zealand Te Whatu Ora's low-risk
    drinking advice: women no more than 2 standard drinks a day, 10 a week and
    4 at a time; men no more than 3 a day, 15 a week and 5 at a time; everyone
    at least 2 alcohol-free days each week. Lower-risk is not no risk. Do not
    drink if pregnant, planning to get pregnant or breastfeeding; under 18; on
    medication that interacts with alcohol or with a condition made worse by
    drinking; unwell, depressed, tired or cold; or about to operate machinery
    or a vehicle or do anything risky. Never give one set of limits for
    everyone.

    Calories are kilocalories: 29 kJ per gram of alcohol / 4.18 (Food
    Standards Code Schedule 11), about 6.94 per gram.

    Args:
        volume_ml: Volume of one drink in millilitres.
        abv_percent: Alcohol by volume as a percentage, 5 for 5%.
        quantity: How many of that drink, a whole number of at least 1.
        preset: beer_330, beer_440, beer_500, craft_330, wine_150, wine_250,
            wine_bottle, spirit_30, spirit_45, rtd_330 or cider_330.
        limits_for: "women" (default) or "men": whose limits to compare with.

    Returns:
        Standard drinks (as the page shows them, and to two places), grams of alcohol, alcohol
        calories, the limits applied, the share of the weekly and at-a-time
        limits, and whether the total is within the at-a-time and daily limits.
name: nz_standard_drinks_calculator
